definition_used: An investigation by the company/institution listed as the affiliation of one or more authors.
caution: The reason indicates an investigation by the affiliated institution, which is a due-process signal but does not specify the underlying problem or outcome. It is a procedural metadata tag, not a direct indicator of manuscript content issues.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes an investigation by the author's affiliated company/institution, which falls under post-publication oversight processes. It does not directly assert problems with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, so only the due-process category is assigned.
